title: Codzienna praca
subtitle: daily, retro, podmiana, klient, ticket i Slack

translations.pl: Na daily mówię, co skończyłam wczoraj
translations.en: In the daily I say what I finished yesterday
accept: At standup I say what I finished yesterday
In the daily I say what I completed yesterday

translations.en: Today I'm taking a regression ticket
accept: Today I am taking a regression ticket
I'm picking up a regression ticket today

translations.pl: Blokuje mnie brak dostępu do środowiska
translations.en: I'm blocked by missing access to the environment
accept: I am blocked by missing access to the environment
Lack of environment access is blocking me

translations.en: I'll finish this before noon
accept: I will finish this before noon
I'll get this done before noon

translations.en: I don't have any blockers
accept: I have no blockers
I don't have blockers

translations.en: After the daily I go back to testing
accept: After standup I go back to testing
After the daily I get back to testing

translations.pl: Na retro mówię, co poszło dobrze
translations.en: In the retro I say what went well
accept: At retro I say what went well
In the retrospective I say what went well

translations.en: We were missing acceptance criteria
accept: We missed acceptance criteria
We didn't have acceptance criteria

translations.en: I suggest a shorter daily
accept: I suggest shorter dailies
I'd suggest a shorter daily

translations.pl: Bierzemy za dużo zgłoszeń do sprintu
translations.en: We take too many tickets into the sprint
accept: We pull too many tickets into the sprint
We take too many tickets into sprint

translations.en: Pairing on tests worked well
accept: Pair testing worked well
Pairing during tests worked well

translations.pl: Na następny sprint chcę mniej równoległych tematów
translations.en: For the next sprint I want fewer parallel topics
accept: Next sprint I want fewer parallel topics
For the next sprint I want less work in parallel

translations.en: We're doing a production swap today
accept: We are doing a production swap today
Today we're swapping production

translations.en: I run smoke tests after the deploy
accept: I check smoke after the deploy
I run a smoke test after the deploy

translations.pl: Rollback jest gotowy, gdyby coś padło
translations.en: The rollback is ready if something goes down
accept: Rollback is ready if something goes down
The rollback is ready if something breaks

translations.en: The maintenance window starts at ten pm
accept: The maintenance window starts at 10 pm
The service window starts at ten pm

translations.pl: Na czacie czekam na zielone od deweloperów
translations.en: On chat I'm waiting for a green light from the developers
accept: On chat I am waiting for a green light from the developers
I'm waiting on chat for a go from the developers

translations.pl: Po podmianie oglądam logi przez godzinę
translations.en: After the swap I watch the logs for an hour
accept: After the swap I check the logs for an hour
After the production swap I watch the logs for an hour

translations.pl: Możemy przejść przez ten błąd razem
translations.en: We can walk through this bug together
accept: Can we walk through this bug together
We can go through this bug together

translations.pl: Widzę to u siebie, dam znać jak znajdę przyczynę
translations.en: I can see it on my side, I'll let you know when I find the cause
accept: I can reproduce it, I'll let you know when I find the cause
I see it on my side, I will let you know when I find the root cause
chunks: I can see it on my side

translations.pl: To nie jest blocker, mamy obejście
translations.en: This isn't a blocker, we have a workaround
accept: This is not a blocker, we have a workaround
It's not a blocker, we have a workaround

translations.en: I'll confirm it on your environment
accept: I will confirm it on your environment
I'll check it on your environment

translations.pl: Dziękuję za nagranie, to bardzo pomaga
translations.en: Thanks for the recording, that helps a lot
accept: Thank you for the recording, that helps a lot
Thanks for the recording, it helps a lot

translations.pl: O której możemy zrobić krótkie demo
translations.en: What time can we do a short demo
accept: When can we do a short demo
What time could we do a short demo

translations.pl: Wrzuć to na Slacka, żebym miała ślad
translations.en: Drop it on Slack so I have a trail
accept: Put it on Slack so I have a trail
Please drop it on Slack so I have a record

translations.en: I'm picking up this ticket from Jira
accept: I am picking up this ticket from Jira
I'll take this ticket from Jira

translations.en: I'm in a meeting until eleven
accept: I am in a meeting until 11
I'm in a meeting until 11

translations.en: I attach a screenshot to the ticket
accept: I add a screenshot to the ticket
I put a screenshot in the ticket

translations.en: After lunch I go back to regression
accept: After lunch I get back to regression
I'll go back to regression after lunch

translations.en: Ping me when the build goes green
accept: Ping me when the build passes
Ping me when the build is green
